correctness.rationale: The k[t]-module decomposition gives a unique n+3-coordinate centralizer normal form. Direct squaring forces d=a(0)=0 and a(t)^2+bc t^(n-1)=0; valuation distinguishes even and odd n without a characteristic assumption. The reduced quadratic and normal-crossing models follow, including irreducibility and singular loci by coprime-coefficient and Jacobian arguments. Image filtration gives rank=n-v for 1<=v<=n-2, with rank-one boundaries; explicit coefficient and scalar-product enumeration gives the stated generating polynomial. The included independent brute-force matrix checker passed all 14 full centralizer enumerations for q=2,3,4,5 and n=3..8 in the specified combinations. Infinite-n claims are proved symbolically, not inferred from finite experiments.

value.rationale: The rank distribution and geometry of the square-zero fiber are intrinsic invariants of the module endomorphism algebra attached to the natural hook Jordan partition (n,1). The parity flip from two affine components to an irreducible quadric, exact singular loci, complete rank multiplicities and acyclic-differential count are linked by one structural argument and hold in every characteristic. This goes beyond a small arbitrary example or a routine scalar substitution, though it does not assert a general partition theorem.
